entries.title: 自媒体爆款流水线：从热点追踪到一键分发
entries.titleEn: Social Media Content Pipeline: From Trend Tracking to Auto-Publishing
entries.text: 做新媒体最头疼的是找选题、写文案、做封面、发多平台。这套组合拳帮你打通全流程：TrendRadar 实时监控全网热点，AI 自动筛选和翻译；marketingskills 提供专业的文案和 SEO 技巧，让内容更吸睛；guizang-social-card-skill 一键生成小红书图文和公众号封面；最后用 claude-skill-social-post 学习你的风格，自动发布到多个平台，还能提前排好 14 天内容日历。装上这几个，你就能从选题到发布全自动，专注内容本身，流量自然来。
entries.textEn: The toughest part of social media is finding topics, writing copy, making covers, and posting across platforms. This combo streamlines the entire workflow: TrendRadar monitors hot topics in real-time with AI filtering and translation; marketingskills provides professional copywriting and SEO techniques to make content pop; guizang-social-card-skill generates Xiaohongshu and WeChat cover images with one click; and claude-skill-social-post learns your style and auto-publishes to multiple platforms, even planning a 14-day content calendar. With these installed, you can go from topic discovery to publishing automatically, focusing on content itself while traffic flows in.

entries.title: 让 AI 编码助手记住一切：代码库记忆增强包
entries.titleEn: Make Your AI Coding Assistant Remember Everything: Codebase Memory Enhancement Pack
entries.text: 每次让 AI 改代码，它总是忘了之前的上下文？这套工具让 AI 拥有长期记忆：claude-mem 提供跨会话持久记忆，自动压缩并注入相关上下文；graphify 把整个代码库变成可查询的知识图谱，支持文档、SQL schema 等；context7 提供最新代码文档，避免 AI 用旧 API。装上这几个，AI 助手就能记住你的项目历史，理解全局，写出更靠谱的代码。
entries.textEn: Tired of AI forgetting context every time you ask it to modify code? This toolkit gives AI long-term memory: claude-mem provides persistent cross-session memory with automatic compression and injection; graphify turns the entire codebase into a queryable knowledge graph, including docs and SQL schemas; context7 supplies up-to-date code documentation to prevent outdated API usage. With these installed, your AI assistant can remember project history, understand the big picture, and write more reliable code.

entries.title: 设计灵感速成：从参考图到设计系统
entries.titleEn: Design Inspiration Accelerator: From Reference to Design System
entries.text: 想要做出高级感设计，却总被说像 AI 生成？这套组合让你轻松驾驭设计：ui-ux-pro-max-skill 提供专业设计知识库，涵盖配色、字体、布局等规则；design-dna 把参考 UI 转化为量化的设计 DNA，生成匹配的界面；hallmark 专治 AI 味，让设计更自然；hue 学习品牌并生成完整设计系统。装上这几个，你就能从参考图到完整设计系统一键生成，设计质感直线上升。
entries.textEn: Want high-end designs but always criticized for looking AI-generated? This combo helps you master design: ui-ux-pro-max-skill provides a professional design knowledge base covering color, typography, layout rules; design-dna converts reference UI into quantifiable design DNA and generates matching interfaces; hallmark removes AI flavor for more natural designs; hue learns brand and generates a complete design system. With these, you can go from reference image to full design system in one click, dramatically improving design quality.

entries.title: 新媒体运营起步套装：热点 → 文案 → 分发一条龙
entries.titleEn: Social Media Starter Kit: trends → copy → publish in one flow
entries.text: 装上这 4 个：TrendRadar 自动盯全网热点、电商视觉文案 Skill 出商品图文案、rayskills 把内容直接排进公众号/X 草稿箱、微信 OpenClaw 通道让 WorkBuddy 直连微信。从选题到发布，每天省 2 小时。
entries.textEn: Install these 4: TrendRadar watches all-platform hot topics, the e-commerce copywriting Skill produces product copy, rayskills pipes drafts straight into WeChat/X, and the OpenClaw WeChat channel connects WorkBuddy to WeChat. Save 2 hours a day from ideation to publish.

entries.title: 开发者效率三件套：让 agent 真正读懂你的代码库
entries.titleEn: Developer Trio: make your agent actually understand the codebase
entries.text: Serena 提供语义级代码检索编辑，codebase-memory-mcp 把代码库索引成持久知识图谱，context-mode 再把工具输出压缩 98%。三者叠加，长会话不爆上下文、agent 改代码不再瞎猜。
entries.textEn: Serena adds semantic code retrieval/editing, codebase-memory-mcp indexes your repo into a persistent knowledge graph, and context-mode compresses tool output by 98%. Together: no context blowups, no more guessing.

entries.title: 设计产出套装：从原型到落地页，全给 agent 装上
entries.titleEn: Design Output Kit: prototypes to landing pages for your agent
entries.text: open-design 把 agent 变成设计引擎（原型/看板/幻灯片导出真实文件），ui-ux-pro-max-skill 提供配色/字体/布局知识库，CodeDrobe Skills 负责给桌面应用换肤。设计师的活，AI 也能出一版。
entries.textEn: open-design turns the agent into a design engine (real HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 exports), ui-ux-pro-max-skill adds palette/typography/layout knowledge, CodeDrobe Skills themes desktop apps. A credible AI first pass on design work.
